digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git repository transfer
propositions: CI workflows for tickets-branch checkout must apply --filter=blob:none to reduce transfer size from >1GB to <100MB while preserving complete commit graph.

Production guards must parse git count-objects -v pack size and reject fetches exceeding REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB (102400 KiB) for standalone and REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB (131072 KiB) for Gerrit workflows.
Real-Git fixture must validate blob:none protocol negotiation via GIT_TRACE_PACKET inspection and confirm promisor blob absence before materialization.
Blobless partial-clone fetches must retain complete commit graph for merge-base and era scoping operations and must not alter git count-objects output after identity verification.
Named-origin fetches inherit filter via Git remote config; direct-URL fetches require explicit --filter=blob:none; depth-1 and full-history semantics must be preserved independently.
